cases.sentence: Филистимляне собрали все свои войска в Афеке, а израилетяне разбили лагерь у ___ в Израиле.
cases.translation: The Philistines gathered all their forces at Aphek, and Israel encamped by the spring in Israel.
cases.explain: The phrase у источника (by the spring) uses genitive after the preposition у.

cases.sentence: Когда филистимские правители шли со своими сотнями и ___ воинов, Давид и его люди шли сзади.
cases.translation: When the Philistine lords passed by hundreds and thousands of warriors, David and his men followed behind.
cases.explain: The phrase сотнями и тысячами uses genitive plural for the number containers.

cases.sentence: Начальники филистимлян спросили, что делают здесь эти ___?
cases.translation: The Philistine princes asked, What are these Hebrews doing here?
cases.explain: These Hebrews serves as the predicate nominative after the verb делают.

cases.sentence: Ахиш ответил, «Ведь это Давид, который был слугой ___ , царя Израиля.»
cases.translation: Achish answered, This is David, who was the servant of Saul, king of Israel.
cases.explain: The genitive case follows the adjective слугой (servant of).

cases.sentence: Он не должен идти с нами на войну, иначе он обратится против нас во время ___.
cases.translation: He must not go with us to battle, or else he may turn against us in the battle.
cases.explain: The preposition во время (during) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Разве это не тот Давид, о котором они танцуя ___?
cases.translation: Is this not David of whom they sang dancing?
cases.explain: The verb пели (sang) must agree with the plural subject они.

cases.sentence: Верно, как и то, что жив ___, ты честен.
cases.translation: As the Lord lives, you are upright.
cases.explain: The nominative case жив Господь is a nominative absolute construction.

cases.sentence: С того дня, когда ты пришел ко мне, и до сегодняшнего ___, я не нашел в тебе ничего плохого.
cases.translation: From the day you came to me until today, I found nothing wrong in you.
cases.explain: The preposition до (until) governs the genitive case.

reading.ru: Филистимляне собрали все свои войска в Афеке, а израилетяне разбили лагерь у источника в Израиле.
reading.question: Where did the Israelites camp?
reading.explain: The Israelites encamped by the spring which is in Jezreel.

reading.ru: Начальники филистимлян спросили, что делают здесь эти евреи? Ахиш ответил, «Ведь это Давид, который был слугой Саула, царя Израиля.»
reading.question: What did Achish say about David?
options: He was a servant of Saul who had been with him
He was a spy sent by Israel
He was a deserter from the army
reading.correct: He was a servant of Saul who had been with him
reading.explain: Achish said David was the servant of Saul and had been with him these years.

reading.ru: Он не должен идти с нами на войну, иначе он обратится против нас во время сражения. Чем еще он мог бы примириться со своим господином, как не головами наших людей?
reading.question: Why were the Philistine princes afraid to have David fight with them?
options: He might turn against them in battle to regain favor with Saul
He was not a skilled warrior
He wanted to become king of Philistia
reading.correct: He might turn against them in battle to regain favor with Saul
reading.explain: The princes feared David would reconcile with his lord by delivering their heads.

reading.ru: Разве это не тот Давид, о котором они танцуя пели? Саул сразил тысячи, а Давид десятки тысяч.
reading.question: What did the people sing about David?
options: Saul killed thousands, but David killed tens of thousands
reading.correct: Saul killed thousands, but David killed tens of thousands
reading.explain: The song compared Saul slaying thousands with David slaying ten thousands.

reading.ru: Ахиш призвал Давида и сказал ему, «Верно, как и то, что жив Господь, ты честен, и мне было бы приятно позволить тебе служить со мной в войске.»
reading.question: What did Achish say about David character?
options: He was upright and Achish would like to keep him in his service
He was too weak to fight
reading.correct: He was upright and Achish would like to keep him in his service
reading.explain: Achish said David was upright and he would be pleased to let him serve with him.

reading.ru: Поворачивай и иди с миром, не делай ничего, что могло бы рассердить филистимских правителей.
reading.question: What did Achish tell David to do?
options: Return and go in peace, do nothing to displease the Philistine lords
Bring him the heads of the other princes
reading.correct: Return and go in peace, do nothing to displease the Philistine lords
reading.explain: Achish told David to return in peace and do nothing to anger the Philistine princes.
